query:
SELECT 
  '2025' as year,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DATE_ADD('2025-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY) as d
    FROM (SELECT a.N + b.N*10 + c.N*100 as n FROM 
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a,
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b,
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3) c
    ) nums
    WHERE DATE_ADD('2025-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY) <= '2025-12-31'
    AND DAYOFWEEK(DATE_ADD('2025-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY)) = 1
  ) sundays) as total_sundays
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '2026' as year,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DATE_ADD('2026-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY) as d
    FROM (SELECT a.N + b.N*10 + c.N*100 as n FROM 
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a,
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b,
      (SELECT 0 as N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3) c
    ) nums
    WHERE DATE_ADD('2026-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY) <= '2026-05-25'
    AND DAYOFWEEK(DATE_ADD('2026-01-01', INTERVAL n DAY)) = 1
  ) sundays) as total_sundays;
